June Local installer

Put the oven in RCM mode:

  1. 1. Connect the oven with the USB cable.
  2. 2. Hold SW2 (FORCE_RECOVERY).
  3. 3. Power the oven on, keep holding SW2 for ~10s.
  4. 4. Press OK to continue.
